LanguageData.Exp_NoLeadText: Nobody on the comms has heard of any {0} out there. Maybe later.
LanguageData.Exp_LeadFoundText: Someone on the comms knows of {0} at a {1} not far from here. It is on the Expeditions map now.
LanguageData.Exp_NoPods: No transport pods with fuel for this distance.
LanguageData.Exp_PodsTooSmall: The pods hold {0} kg; the squad weighs {1} kg.
LanguageData.Exp_ShuttleFuel: The shuttle needs fuel for the trip there and back.
LanguageData.Exp_ShuttleTooSmall: The squad does not fit in the shuttle.
LanguageData.Exp_NeedConsole: Needs a powered comms console on this map.
LanguageData.Exp_PawnBusy: Someone in the squad is already on an expedition.
LanguageData.Exp_PawnUnavailable: Someone in the squad cannot leave right now.
LanguageData.Exp_NoPath: There is no way to get there on foot.
LanguageData.Exp_NotEnoughMedicine: Not enough medicine to give: needs {0}, has {1}.
LanguageData.Exp_Departed: The squad has set out for the {0}.
LanguageData.Exp_DepartureCancelled: The expedition to the {0} was called off: the squad fell apart before leaving.
LanguageData.Exp_DeathText: {0} died on the expedition to the {1}. The others carry on.
LanguageData.Exp_CapturedText: {0} was taken by {1} at the {2}. You can try to get them back from the Captured tab of the Expeditions window.
LanguageData.Exp_LostText: Nobody is coming back from the {0}.
LanguageData.Exp_ReturnedAsCaravan: The colony is gone, so the squad stayed together as a caravan where they left from.
LanguageData.Exp_Outcome_Gone: The site was gone by the time they got there.
LanguageData.Exp_Outcome_CutShort: They turned back before the job was done.
LanguageData.Exp_Found: They found what they were looking for.
LanguageData.Exp_GoodwillAllExceptLine: Word of it travels: goodwill with every other faction +{0}
LanguageData.Exp_CertaintyLine: Those who went came back surer of their faith.
LanguageData.Exp_SuppliesGivenLine: Given away: {0} nutrition of food and {1} medicine.
LanguageData.Exp_CaptivesNoWardenLine: {0} captive(s) brought home as prisoners: nobody free came back to enslave them.
LanguageData.Exp_CaptivesFreedLine: With nobody left to hold them, {0} captive(s) got away.
LanguageData.Exp_MechsNoMechanitor: The mechs they found woke, but with no mechanitor in the squad nobody could take control. They were left behind.
LanguageData.Exp_MechsNoneAvailable: None of the mechs they found were of a kind the colony can take yet. They were left behind.
LanguageData.Exp_RecalledLine: The reason for going was gone, and they were called home.
LanguageData.Exp_RecalledCancelled: The expedition to the {0} was called off: there's no reason to go any more.
LanguageData.Exp_SettlementRazed: {0} was razed. Nothing stands there now.
LanguageData.Exp_SettlementRaided: {0} was raided, but it still stands.
LanguageData.Exp_GizmoDesc: Open the expeditions map: send squads out, ask around for items, follow who is away and who is held.
LanguageData.Exp_NoOffers: Nothing on the board right now. New opportunities turn up every few days, or ask around in Prospect.
LanguageData.Exp_SelectOpportunity: Pick an opportunity from the list or the map.
LanguageData.Exp_Supplies: Of that, {0} is to give away, with {1} medicine (has {2})
LanguageData.Exp_LinkSiteLost: The site is lost: whatever was there is out of reach now.
LanguageData.Exp_RetaliationLine: They were seen leaving. Expect {0} to answer within a day of their return.
LanguageData.Exp_WorksiteTooFar: The site will be gone before this squad gets there.
LanguageData.Exp_WorksiteGoneCancelled: The expedition to the {0} was called off: the site is gone.
LanguageData.Exp_ClickToRemove: Click to remove from the squad.
LanguageData.Exp_NoGoContract: contract ends in {0}, trip takes {1} days
LanguageData.Exp_NeedOverlord: Slaves need a free colonist of your own to keep them in line.
LanguageData.Exp_SlavesFled: With nobody left to keep them in line, the slaves fled.
LanguageData.Exp_PawnPulled: {0} was called away and left the squad.
LanguageData.Exp_HireesTookAll: {0} turned on the squad when {1} broke with the colony, and made off with everything from the {2}.
LanguageData.Exp_HireesSlipped: {0} slipped away in the night with {1} after their people broke with the colony.
LanguageData.Exp_HireesCaught: {0} tried to slip away after their people broke with the colony, and were caught.
LanguageData.Exp_HireesWon: {0} got away with the animals, the ride and the cargo. The rest walked home.
LanguageData.Exp_CreepLeft: {0} walked off one night and did not come back.
LanguageData.Exp_CreepFleshbeasts: {0} burst into fleshbeasts in the middle of the camp.
LanguageData.Exp_CreepSightstealers: {0} let out a howl, and sightstealers came out of nowhere.
LanguageData.Exp_RideTip_Foot: Slow both ways, but quiet: stealth counts in full. They carry only what they can.
LanguageData.Exp_RideTip_DropPods: Fast there, the pods are used up, and they walk home. Loud: no sneaking in.
LanguageData.Exp_RideTip_Shuttle: Fast both ways with room for a lot of loot. Loud: no sneaking in.
LanguageData.Exp_RideTip_Vehicles: Faster than walking, with cargo room. Armed vehicles sometimes help in a fight. Loud.
LanguageData.Exp_ProspectHelp: Search for an item and ask around for it. The rarer and more advanced it is, the less likely anyone knows where to find it.
LanguageData.Exp_ProspectInProgress: Someone has already started asking; the next colonist picks up where they stopped.
LanguageData.Exp_NoActive: No squads out, and no reports yet.
LanguageData.Exp_SelectExpedition: Pick a squad or a report.
LanguageData.Exp_NoCaptives: Nobody from the colony is held by anyone.
LanguageData.Exp_CapturedHelp: Colonists held by other factions, whether taken on an expedition or kidnapped by raiders. Pick one to plan a rescue.
LanguageData.Exp_NoRescueSite: Nowhere in range to look for them.
LanguageData.Exp_RecallNoPods: Drop pods can't fly back for them. They'll come home once the job is done.
LanguageData.Exp_PlayerRecalled: The squad on the way to the {0} was called home. The opportunity is still on the board.
LanguageData.Exp_PlayerRecalledLine: They were called home before they got there.
